name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused BTPM product improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

## Problem / user need

Describe the delivery or transformation-management problem to solve.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the behavior or capability you would expect, without prescribing unnecessary implementation detail.

## Scope

Which BTPM area is affected (for example Project, Phase, Task, Risk, Blocker, KPI, Portfolio, reporting, REST API or MCP)?

## Source-of-truth impact

Would the proposal introduce new stored data? If so, explain why it cannot be derived safely from existing canonical source data.

## Security / tenancy considerations

Note any expected impact on roles, authorization, Tenant/Organization/Workspace/Project containment, integrations, encryption or sensitive data.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any simpler workflow or existing capability that was considered.
